title: 교통과 이동: 환승, 막차, 연착까지
objective: By the end, you can use ten intermediate transport words, such as 환승, 막차, 연착되다 and 벌금, in short sentences about buses, trains, driving and travel tickets.
summary: Ten intermediate words for getting around in Korea: public transport, driving, and booking travel tickets.

task.title: Use the transport words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, write, or change the word from this worksheet so it fits.

words.meaning: transfer (changing to another line or bus)
words.exampleMeaning: Transfer to Line 2 at City Hall Station.

words.meaning: route (of a bus or subway line)
words.example: 버스 노선이 바뀌어서 이제 우리 집 앞에 안 서요.
words.exampleMeaning: The bus route changed, so it doesn't stop in front of my house anymore.

words.meaning: the last bus or train of the night
words.example: 막차를 놓쳐서 택시를 타고 집에 갔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I missed the last train, so I took a taxi home.
It's rush hour, so the traffic is really bad.

words.meaning: to run, to operate (of a bus or train service)
words.exampleMeaning: This bus does not run on weekends.

words.meaning: to arrive late, to be delayed
words.exampleMeaning: The train was 30 minutes late because of the snow.
You must not speed in front of a school.

words.meaning: a fine (money paid as a penalty)
words.exampleMeaning: I paid a fine for illegal parking.
One one-way ticket to Busan, please.
It's a long holiday, so I booked a round-trip train ticket in advance.

exercises: Choose the right word: 비행기 표를 (편도 / 왕복)(으)로 샀어요. 다음 주 금요일에 돌아올 거예요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 밤늦게 ____을/를 타려고 역까지 뛰어갔어요.
Fill in each blank with the right word from the list. For ③, use the past tense: ① 주차를 잘못해서 ____ 고지서가 집으로 왔어요. ② 사고가 나서 고속도로에 ____이/가 생겼어요. ③ 태풍 때문에 배가 두 시간 ____.
Change 운행하다 into the polite present form: 이 지하철은 새벽 5시 반부터 ____.
Fill in the blank with a word from the list + 하세요: 여기에서 버스를 타고 서울역에서 지하철 4호선으로 ____.
Choose the right word: ① 고속도로에서 (과속 / 노선)을 해서 경찰에게 잡혔어요. ② 이 버스 (과속 / 노선)이 바뀌어서 정류장이 멀어졌어요.
answers: ① 벌금 ② 교통 체증 ③ 연착됐어요 (연착되었어요)
